n = int(input().strip())
s = input().strip()

# Without copy: n operations.
# If we type first k characters, then copy the current string once,
# the built string becomes s[:2k]. This is useful only if s[:k] == s[k:2k].
# Then total operations = k (typing) + 1 (copy) + (n - 2k) (remaining chars)
# = n - k + 1. So we want the largest valid k with 2k <= n.

best = n
for k in range(1, n // 2 + 1):
    if s[:k] == s[k:2*k]:
        best = min(best, n - k + 1)

print(best)
